title: Clue by Function · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Clue by Function · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead writes the name of a common household object. The lead describes one function of the object without naming it. Another player guesses the written object. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Clue by Function, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Another player guesses the written object.
recall.why: Another player guesses the written object.
